name: Machine Chest Press
summary: A guided machine pressing movement that builds upper-body pushing strength and hypertrophy in the chest, shoulders, and triceps.

setup: Adjust the seat height so the machine handles sit level with your mid-to-lower chest.
Sit back firmly against the backrest with your head supported and feet planted flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand or neutral grip and set your shoulder blades back and down against the pad.
steps: Press the handles away by extending your elbows and squeezing your chest.
Continue pushing until your arms are nearly straight, avoiding harsh elbow lockout.
Lower the handles smoothly back under control until you feel a comfortable stretch across the chest, without letting the weight plates touch.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you press the weight forward and inhale as you return the handles to the starting position.
cues: Keep your shoulders pinned to the back pad.
Drive your elbows across your chest.

common_faults.fault: Protracted, internally rotated shoulders at the peak of the press.
common_faults.correction: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed against the backrest throughout the entire movement.

common_faults.fault: Seat positioned too high or too low, misaligning the wrists and shoulders.
common_faults.correction: Adjust the seat so the handles align directly with the middle of your sternum.

common_faults.fault: Allowing the weight stack to bounce at the bottom of the rep.
common_faults.correction: Reverse direction smoothly before the weight stack collides to maintain constant muscular tension.

precautions: Do not overextend your shoulder range of motion backward beyond comfortable joint mobility.
